go-ibkr 0.1.3

- Added a "Finding endpoints and types" section to SKILL.md, with usage of go doc and package documentation details.
- Clarified method-naming and parameter conventions for generated endpoint methods.
- Declared the package license as MIT in the skill manifest.
- Removed the redundant skill-card.md file.

- Updated description and documentation to clarify usage scenarios, security considerations, and setup steps for `go-ibkr`.
- Improved guidance on authentication using Client Portal Gateway and OAuth methods.
- Expanded security instructions to highlight safe handling of credentials and HTTPS connections.
- Added practical Go code usage examples and tips on response handling.
- Clarified when to use and not use this package, emphasizing its unofficial status and scope.
